scope: LightTimeline evaluator, configuration parsing, schema and regression tests
review_checks: Key times are finite, start at zero and increase strictly, with at most256keys. Invalid data leaves output unchanged.
Finite nonnegative key multipliers validate their base-illuminance product rather than imposing an extra multiplier cap, preserving valid zero-base tracks.
Non-looping evaluation holds the final key. Looping requires a positive final key time and wraps exact periods to the first key. Empty looping tracks remain identity.
upper_bound ensures step changes occur at the key time and linear evaluation uses the bracketing keys. Positive finite time differences and endpoint products bound interpolation.
Stateless lookup supports arbitrary seek order. Configuration rejects unknown fields and malformed nested key objects and commits only after complete validation.
